title: Find recent Copilot cloud agent and code review runs with gh api (event=dynamic + path filter)
answers: how do I find recent Copilot cloud agent runs in mlflow
how to list copilot-setup-steps workflow runs with gh api
where do I see Copilot code review runs for a pull request
why does gh run list not show Copilot agent or review runs
body:
Copilot cloud agent and Copilot code review runs are dynamic workflow runs, so list them via the Actions runs API filtered by event=dynamic, not via `gh run list`.
Command: gh api '/repos/mlflow/mlflow/actions/runs?event=dynamic&per_page=100' --jq '.workflow_runs[] | select(.path == "<path>") | {id, name, created_at, conclusion, html_url}'
Cloud agent setup runs: <path> = dynamic/copilot-swe-agent/copilot (documented in .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml header comment).
Code review runs: <path> = dynamic/agents/copilot-pull-request-reviewer (documented in .github/workflows/copilot-code-review.yml header comment).
The API returns at most 100 runs per page, so the jq filter only sees the most recent 100 dynamic runs; if the target run is older, add pagination rather than assuming it is absent.
The filter matches on the run's .path field, which is the dynamic path string above, not the display name; use the exact string.
applies: Maintainer-side lookup of Copilot agent/review runs in the mlflow/mlflow repo; the path strings are specific to this repo's dynamic workflows.
